text: The Claude adapter v0.101.0 declares `_meta.claudeCode.promptQueueing`. A `session/prompt` sent during a turn gets its own turn after the running one, and its own reply, in order. A v1 client gets no message when a queued turn starts. Only the v2 path sends `user_message` then. A `session/cancel` cancels every prompt received so far. Source: `startTurn` and `cancelTurns` in the adapter's bundled JavaScript.
